shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A woman in a green shirt sits at the counter-side window seat and listens to the puzzling story, while a man in an orange shirt sits at the plant-side window seat and a man in a white shirt sits at the plant-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the café counter end, looking along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and the plant-end seat and the floor plant in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt and a man in an orange shirt exchange seats; she questions the impossible details in the story, and he dismisses the objection.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in the orange shirt insists that the story proceed without interruption.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the counter-side window seat.

shots.content: The woman in the green shirt questions another strange constraint in the story.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the rectangular table.
